title: My MallWorld has become very consistent and layered recently.
content: I’ve been revisiting the same place for years now, a major city that has many different areas and in the middle of it all is a giant mall with parking lots and walkways like a new york style building or like Tokyos Shibuya crossing. Theres many levels to this Mall. Inside, the lower levels active and crowded like with shops, the movie theatres, restaurants, bars, nightclubs, shops, even concert stages and a hotel that seems to go on forever. one of the most recurring dreams i have of this mall world is the waterpark and the hotels. theres like multiple waterparks i think, ive been to a couple that were themed differently but this one last night had a water slide that costed 2$ which was a toonie for me (canada). ive dreamed of going down the slide more than once even worrying about getting my phone wet. the physical sensation is vivid like that feeling when you go on that ride at a fair the big drop. but yeah it felt very real and weird i even had my phone with me. the hotel section is another part. each floor has different rooms consisting of parties, room mates, people’s rooms, and many people in the elevators trying to get to their rooms. i don’t know if others know this but i seen it on a tiktok comment😂 that there’s a secret elevator for staff that is rarely used and i somehow managed to use it constantly when im there lol. idk if it’s just a coincidence or something. also the higher you go on this hotel or mall the less people you find here, almost like the backrooms and it’s abandoned but not really abandoned i guess just waiting for more people to find it? idk i always find myself going back down because it’s lonely and sometimes scary. just wanted to share my experience because it’s been happening a lot lately and just last night it happened again so i’ve been feeling like it’s either an escape from reality or whatever else it could be because i usually never dream of anything else and when i do it’s never bad. just that big drop on the water slide kinda hurt lol does anyone else have the mall world remembered this much? maybe we’ve met haha jk (sorry for the grammar i just woke up, too lazy for correcting.)
